content.text:
All 18 rules reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations redlined (8)**
- **LOL-CAP** (critical): cap protects TrueLink only; Client uncapped. Made mutual at 12 months' fees with uncapped Excluded Claims and fees carve-out.
- **INDEMN** (critical): vendor indemnity covers only its own breach — no third-party IP infringement cover. Added the standard vendor indemnity.
- **IP** (critical): §8(d) lets TrueLink distribute/license/resell/exploit Credit Data; no Client ownership statement. Narrowed to service delivery and added retained-ownership sentence.
- **ASSIGN**: consent gate with affiliate-only carve-out; added M&A/successor carve-out and reasonableness standard.
- **LICENSE**: grant excludes affiliates/contractors with no path to add; inserted them.
- **WARRANTY**: only a Y2K warranty behind a broad disclaimer; added workmanlike + 90-day conformance warranty with remedy.
- **TRANSITION**: no data return or exit assistance; inserted 6-month assistance, 30-day export, certified deletion.
- **INSURANCE** (missing): no insurance clause for a hosting vendor handling credit data; inserted new §31.

**Compliant / no redline (10)**: NONCOMPETE (§2(a) preserves our freedom — note the separate Non-Competition Agreement needs diligence), EXCLUSIVITY (narrow §3(i) tie-in only), MFN (runs in our favour), NOSOLICIT (none), T4C (Client at-will exit, no vendor convenience right), RENEWAL (12-month renewals, 30-day window), GOVLAW (California law/courts — fallback), AUDIT (no audit right against us), LD (none payable by us), MINCOMMIT (monthly minimum exitable at will; blanks must be completed).
